text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is an original research article focusing on predicting future distributions of emergent aquatic macrophytes—species-specific ecological elements—across boreal catchments in Finland under climate change scenarios. The primary focus is on species distribution modeling and ecological impacts rather than land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. Although spatial modeling with quantitative metrics and multiple future climate scenarios are used at a national scale, the study does not model or predict LULC changes themselves, but rather biotic responses to climate variables. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation and is excluded.)
